title: koeleria spicata subsp. wrangelensis
intro: Koeleria spicata subsp. wrangelensis, commonly known as Wrangel's Koeleria or Wrangel's Hair-grass, is a subspecies of grass native to the Kuril Islands. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues, including inflammation, digestive problems, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Koeleria spicata subsp. wrangelensis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
